notes:
Initial demo 2026-02-27. Mid-market B2B product analytics company building an in-app assistant + semantic search. Currently on another LLM API provider; motivated to migrate for cost + control.

POC path: Hosted API for fast eval -> Dedicated reserved capacity for production. Customer asked for a compatibility/compat layer so existing prompts + SDK calls map 1:1 to Redwood responses. Biggest risk: prompt parity/regressions. SE observed style drift on ~3% of sampled prompts during demo — flagged.

Key metrics / asks: p95 latency <250ms for 512-token chat, throughput ~60 qps aggregate, target 30-40% lower per-token cost vs current provider for production. Prefer Llama-family or equivalent open model variants; require routing/fallback policy for regional traffic.

Security / compliance: SSO (SAML), audit logging, KMS for key management, EU data residency requirement for portion of customer data. Submitted security questionnaire 2026-03-05 (see security_faq_responses.docx).

Quotes / customer voice: CTO Marcus Li — "We can't ship if the assistant answers differently on critical flows. Prompt parity is non-negotiable." Head of ML Dana Cruz — wants an eval harness to quantify regressions.

Action items: SE to run batch prompt-parity test against their 25k prompt set and share results; Redwood infra to propose VPC peering plan; Pricing to provide committed Dedicated estimates for 4x A100-equivalent capacity and a 12-month ARR proposal. Finance call requested week of 2026-03-15.

Risks: If parity is not achieved in POC, customer will likely stay with current provider. Jira ticket INF-3421 opened for SDK compat issues.
